source_text: Concaluit cor meum intra me; in meditatione mea exardescet ignis. Notum fac mihi Domine finem meum. Gloria Christo. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: My heart grew hot within me; in my meditation a fire will kindle. Make known to me, Lord, my end. Glory to Christ. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[My heart became hot within me; as I mused, the fire burned >> Bible:Psalm 39:3]]. [[Make me know my end, O Lord >> Bible:Psalm 39:4]]. Glory to Christ. Amen.
